stories.name: María Corina Machado returns to Venezuela
facts: Opposition leader and 2025 Nobel Peace Prize laureate María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela after about 10 months abroad, announcing: "I am here. With you."
She was seen at a church in Lara state, where dozens of supporters greeted and hugged her, some recording on raised phones (AP).
Venezuela has been run by acting president Delcy Rodríguez, with US backing, since the US military removed Nicolás Maduro in January 2026; no election has been scheduled.

stories.name: Attorney general defends DOJ's pre-emptive lawsuit over Alaska Senate race
facts: The Justice Department filed a lawsuit last week to pre-emptively challenge certification of Alaska's Senate race if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan loses to Democrat Mary Peltola.
Attorney General Todd Blanche defended the suit in Sunday TV interviews (CBS's Face the Nation and CNN's State of the Union).
Asked Friday about the lawsuit, President Trump said he was the one who told the department to do it.
The midterm election is next week.
